title: σωτηρία ἀπὸ Λύκου
learning_goal: Practice present-tense narration with first/second-person statements and imperatives, using vocatives with ὦ and explicit subjects/objects.
plot: Glaux and Panda play ball by the tree until Lukos approaches, and Ὑπερβρέφος drives him away with a thrown stone.

frames.text: ἡ Γλαῦξ καὶ ἡ Πάνδα παίζουσιν μετὰ τῆς σφαίρας παρὰ τῷ δένδρῳ.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Panda stands on the left foreground facing right in three-quarter view, looking at Glaux with a relaxed smile.
Glaux stands on the right foreground facing left in three-quarter view, looking at Panda attentively.
The small tan leather ball sits between Panda and Glaux at knee height on the grass, slightly left of center.
The pale-gray river stone lies on the cobblestone path near the tree roots at the lower right of frame.
motivations: Panda is happy and focused because she is playing catch with her friend Glaux under the tree.
Glaux is calm and engaged because she is playing the ball game with Panda in the sunshine.
frames.artist_notes: Bright sunny day; cottage far behind the friendly shade tree.
frames.camera: Wide establishing shot of the tree foregrounded with the cottage far behind; calm, playful scene.

frames.text: ἐγώ νῦν βάλλω τὴν σφαῖραν, ὦ Γλαῦξ.
frames.speaker: Panda
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Panda remains on the left foreground facing right, arm extended mid-throw, eyes on Glaux; front three-quarter view.
Glaux remains on the right foreground facing left, wings slightly raised to catch, eyes on the incoming ball; three-quarter view.
The small tan leather ball arcs gently between them, slightly above center frame.
The pale-gray river stone remains on the cobblestone near the tree roots at the lower right.
motivations: Panda is excited because she wants to throw the ball to Glaux during their game.
Glaux is alert and ready because she intends to catch the ball Panda throws.
frames.camera: Medium two-shot of Panda and Glaux facing each other with the ball between them.

frames.text: ὁ Λύκος νῦν προσέρχεται πρὸς τὸ δένδρον.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Panda stands left-midground turning her head right toward Lukos, body still angled toward Glaux; three-quarter view.
Glaux stands right-midground turning her head right to notice Lukos, ball now secured lightly near her feet; three-quarter view.
The small tan leather ball rests near Glaux’s talons on the grass, slightly right of center.
The pale-gray river stone still lies by the tree roots at the lower right.
Lukos steps into frame from the far right midground, angled left toward the others, looking at Panda and Glaux with a sly expression; three-quarter view.
motivations: Panda is surprised and uneasy because she sees Lukos approaching their tree while they play.
Glaux is wary because she notices Lukos coming near their play area.
Lukos is hungry and sly because he intends to get close to the smaller animals.
frames.camera: Pan right to reveal Lukos entering; settle into a three-shot with Glaux, Panda, and Lukos.

frames.speaker: Lukos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Panda retreats a half-step on the left, facing right but leaning back, eyes wide on Lukos; three-quarter front view.
Glaux stands to the right, body angled left but slightly back, eyes fixed on Lukos; three-quarter front view.
The small tan leather ball lies between Glaux and Panda on the grass.
The pale-gray river stone remains by the tree roots at the lower right.
Lukos stands nearer center-right, leaning forward with a sly half-grin, eyes on Panda and Glaux; three-quarter view.
motivations: Panda is frightened because Lukos openly threatens to eat her and Glaux.
Glaux is alarmed because Lukos declares his intention to eat them.
Lukos is menacing because he wants to scare them and take advantage of them.
frames.camera: Hold on the group; Lukos dominates the frame as he speaks, with the others reacting.

frames.speaker: Glaux
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Glaux fills the right side in a tight two-shot, head turned left-back toward the distant house as she calls; three-quarter close view.
Panda fills the left side, glancing toward the house with worry, paws near the ball; three-quarter close view.
The small tan leather ball sits near Panda’s feet at the bottom center.
The pale-gray river stone lies off to the lower right by the roots, mostly out of frame but still present.
motivations: Glaux calls urgently because Lukos threatened them and she needs Ὑπερβρέφος to help immediately.
Panda is anxious and looks toward the house because she hopes Ὑπερβρέφος will come quickly.
frames.artist_notes: Keep Lukos out of this tight reaction shot.
frames.camera: Tight two-shot on Glaux and Panda showing their worried reaction as Glaux calls for help.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος ἀκούει τὴν φωνὴν καὶ τρέχει ἐκ τῆς οἰκίας.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: a low arched wooden doorway with warm light spilling toward the exit.
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος is at the center-left in a runner’s stance facing right toward the doorway, eyes focused outside; three-quarter view.
The low arched wooden doorway is at the right, light streaming outward toward Ὑπερβρέφος.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος is determined and quick because he hears Glaux’s urgent voice and wants to help his friends immediately.
frames.artist_notes: Show a clear shaft of light leading toward the exit.
frames.camera: Medium on the cozy doorway area with a guiding beam of light; feel the start of a swift dash.

frames.text: ὁ Ὑπερβρέφος λαμβάνει τὸν λίθον καὶ βάλλει τὸν λίθον πρὸς τὸν Λύκον.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος bursts in from the left foreground, crouched and then rising into a throw toward the right; eyes locked on Lukos.
Lukos stands mid-right, shoulders flinching back, eyes widening at Ὑπερβρέφος.
Panda stands behind and left of Ὑπερβρέφος, watching with hopeful surprise; three-quarter view.
Glaux stands behind and right of Ὑπερβρέφος, watching the stone leave his hand; three-quarter view.
The small tan leather ball rests near Panda’s feet, slightly left of center.
The pale-gray river stone is in motion, flying from Ὑπερβρέφος’ hand toward Lukos.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος acts bravely because he wants to protect his friends from Lukos.
Lukos is startled and defensive because a stone is coming toward him.
Panda is relieved and hopeful because Ὑπερβρέφος has arrived to help.
Glaux is focused and confident because her call for help was answered.
frames.artist_notes: Include an insert feeling on the stone leaving the tiny but powerful hand.
frames.camera: Tracking shot arrives with Ὑπερβρέφος; reframe to a wide that includes all four as the stone flies.

frames.text: ὦ Λύκε, μὴ προσέρχου πρὸς τοὺς φίλους ἐμοὺς.
frames.speaker: Hyperbrephos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Ὑπερβρέφος stands center-left in a heroic stance facing right, arm extended from the throw, eyes fixed on Lukos.
Lukos stands center-right recoiling, ears back, eyes on Ὑπερβρέφος.
Panda stands left background behind Ὑπερβρέφος, eyes on Lukos; three-quarter view.
Glaux stands right background behind Ὑπερβρέφος, eyes on Lukos; three-quarter view.
The small tan leather ball stays near Panda’s feet.
The pale-gray river stone now lies on the ground near Lukos’s feet to the right of center.
motivations: Ὑπερβρέφος speaks firmly because he wants to stop Lukos from approaching his friends.
Lukos is intimidated because Ὑπερβρέφος shows strength and resolve.
Panda is encouraged because Ὑπερβρέφος defends her and Glaux.
Glaux is relieved because Lukos is being confronted.
frames.camera: Medium emphasizing Ὑπερβρέφος in the foreground with Lukos in the opposing plane.

frames.text: οἴμοι· μὴ βάλλε τὸν λίθον εἰς ἐμέ· ἐγώ ἀπέρχομαι νῦν.
frames.speaker: Lukos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Lukos fills the right-center in a medium close-up, leaning back with raised hands, eyes on Ὑπερβρέφος.
Ὑπερβρέφος remains left-midground, steady and watchful, eyes on Lukos.
Panda stands left background, peeking past Ὑπερβρέφος at Lukos; three-quarter view.
Glaux stands right background behind Ὑπερβρέφος, looking at Lukos; three-quarter view.
The small tan leather ball rests by Panda’s feet at the left.
The pale-gray river stone lies on the ground near Lukos’s feet at right-center.
motivations: Lukos pleads because he fears being hit by the stone again and wants to escape.
Ὑπερβρέφος holds firm because he is protecting his friends from danger.
Panda watches tensely because the confrontation may be ending.
Glaux watches calmly because Lukos appears ready to leave.
frames.camera: Medium close-up on Lukos as he pleads; others remain readable in the background.

frames.text: ὁ Λύκος φεύγει ἀπὸ τοῦ δένδρου.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Lukos backs away toward the far right edge, turned three-quarters away, glancing back nervously.
Ὑπερβρέφος stands center-left, squared shoulders facing right, eyes tracking Lukos as he leaves.
Panda stands further left behind Ὑπερβρέφος, relaxing slightly, eyes on Lukos.
Glaux stands right of Panda, wings lowering, eyes on Lukos.
The small tan leather ball remains near Panda’s feet at the left.
The pale-gray river stone stays on the ground near where Lukos stood, mid-right.
motivations: Lukos is retreating because he is afraid of another stone and no longer wants to fight.
Ὑπερβρέφος watches to ensure Lukos truly leaves to keep his friends safe.
Panda begins to relax because the danger is passing.
Glaux feels relieved because Lukos is leaving the tree.
frames.camera: Wide shot as Lukos backs away and exits the frame to the right.

frames.speaker: Panda
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Panda stands left-center turned toward Ὑπερβρέφος, smiling up at him; three-quarter view.
Ὑπερβρέφος stands center-right facing Panda with a gentle heroic posture, eyes soft on Panda.
Glaux enters at the far right edge holding the ball lightly in her talons, looking toward Panda and Ὑπερβρέφος.
The small tan leather ball is now in Glaux’s talons at the right edge.
The pale-gray river stone remains on the ground mid-right where it landed.
motivations: Panda expresses gratitude because Ὑπερβρέφος protected her and Glaux from Lukos.
Ὑπερβρέφος is modest and pleased because he successfully helped his friends.
Glaux is content and rejoining the game, carrying the ball back toward Panda.
frames.camera: Medium two-shot on Panda and Ὑπερβρέφος; Glaux enters at the edge with the ball.

frames.text: ἡ Γλαῦξ καὶ ἡ Πάνδα πάλιν παίζουσιν μετὰ τῆς σφαίρας.
frames.speaker: Didaskalos
objects: a small tan leather ball with blue stitching, smooth and round, sized for a child's hands.
a palm-sized pale-gray river stone, oval and smooth, easy for a child to grip.
positioning: Panda returns to the left foreground facing right with a relaxed stance, eyes on Glaux; three-quarter view.
Glaux returns to the right foreground facing left, wing lifted to toss the ball back; three-quarter view.
The small tan leather ball hovers between them mid-arc as they resume play.
The pale-gray river stone lies undisturbed mid-right near the path.
motivations: Panda is cheerful because the danger is gone and the game can continue.
Glaux is happy and calm because Lukos has left and she can play again.
frames.artist_notes: Peaceful reset; Lukos is gone from the area.
frames.camera: Comfortable wide showing both friends resuming their spacing and play under the tree.
